name: Fudgy Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a 9x13 inch baking pan.
Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Remove from heat.
Stir in sugar, eggs, and vanilla until well combined.
Add cocoa powder, flour, salt, and baking powder. Mix until just combined.
Spread batter evenly into prepared pan.
Bake 20-25 minutes until a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Cool completely in pan before cutting.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free butter and dairy-free chocolate chips.
substitutions.vegan: Use vegan butter and replace each egg with a flax egg.

notes: Underbake slightly for fudgy centers — they continue cooking in the pan.
